nodes.label: What the Title Names — Three Changes, Each a Finding
nodes.rationale: Each title change records a finding rather than a preference: the object's computed shape renamed it a cylinder, the method outgrowing the object demoted the object's name, and gathering the languages supplied a subtitle clause. Two candidate subtitles were rejected because one asserts Lambda as a privileged target and the other keeps the price while losing the plurality.

nodes.label: The Transitions Speak the Languages
nodes.rationale: The grammar is the claim: the exact J multiset is identical in jK, LS, LK and jj, so these are one transition said four ways rather than four accounts of one, and the 2.17-fold spread in cell count is what each saying costs. The atom does not prefer a scheme; the index remembers the route.

nodes.label: Why the Method Precedes the Object in the Title
nodes.rationale: The method is what generalises and the object is what tested it: Lambda closes, and so do the nucleon index, the string partition function, the Kreuzer-Skarke frontier and the book's own mathematics. What travels between them is build the index, close it, read E(X), record every failure.

nodes.label: The Cells Are Transitions, Not States
nodes.rationale: Lambda fibres over q, a difference, not over any property of a single configuration, and there is no factorisation that does not pass through the transfer; every structural result — two-body fibres, the A_q/B_q trade, g <= q as the most active constraint, modular rank — follows from that.

nodes.label: A Phase Space With the Hamiltonian Removed
nodes.rationale: 1,113,045,672 maximal chains satisfy every constraint in the book and Aufbau is one of them, so structure does not choose — energy does, entering only through measured levels. Such a space can bound and refuse and cannot predict.
